findings.title: [P2] Preserve empty trimmed names instead of applying the fallback
findings.body: For `{ name: "" }` or `{ name: "   " }`, the previous nullish fallback returned the trimmed empty string. Using `name || "Anonymous"` now returns `"Anonymous"`, changing the existing API behavior for valid boundary inputs. Use a nullish check if empty strings must remain distinct from missing names.

findings.title: [P2] Preserve empty trimmed names instead of applying the fallback
findings.body:
For valid inputs such as `{ name: "" }` or `{ name: "   " }`, the previous implementation returned `""` after trimming. The truthiness fallback now returns `"Anonymous"`, changing the existing API result contract for boundary inputs.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._
